objectives.title: Processor Identity Recordkeeping
objectives.description: The contract contains provisions regarding identification details maintained within processing logs.
criteria: Documentation identifying designated data protection officers.
Identification of the controller's or processor's representative, where applicable.

objectives.title: Processing Category Documentation
objectives.description: The contract contains provisions regarding tracking operations performed on customer data.
criteria: Specification of the categories of processing carried out on behalf of the controller.
Attribution of the documented processing categories to the specific controller for whom they are carried out.

objectives.title: Cross-Border Transfer Documentation
objectives.description: The contract contains provisions regarding recording extraterritorial personal data transmissions.

objectives.title: Technical Security Documentation
objectives.description: The contract contains provisions regarding descriptive logs of implemented safeguard measures.
criteria: Descriptive logs of implemented technical security measures.
Descriptive logs of implemented organisational security measures.

objectives.title: Record Medium Specifications
objectives.description: The contract contains provisions regarding the medium used for maintaining processing activity logs.
criteria: Maintenance of activity records in written format.
Recognition of electronic form as satisfying the written-record requirement.

objectives.title: Supervisory Authority Record Production
objectives.description: The contract contains provisions regarding delivering activity records to regulatory bodies.
criteria: Obligation to make processing records available to the supervisory authority upon request.
Extension of the record-availability obligation to the controller's or processor's representative, where applicable.
